appearances.snippet: we cannot say for certainty that Israel called the shots and this is how it happened but it is definitively I think a thread that a lot of us would like to ... see pulled

records.text: Kent cited for phones
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Joe Kent, who I think would have the right to assert it, noted that there were 12 Israeli cell phones on the ground that day.

records.text: Israel prediction retained
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I do think that at the end of this, we are going to find that Israel was. ... involved, I do.
